name: pit_beast
description: a Pit Beast, a hulking demonic hound with red-and-orange skin and patches of dark grey hide pinned with steel staples, a row of pale bone spikes along its back, a curved dark horn rising behind its head, a cluster of glowing orange eyes, a huge open maw lined with pale fangs and fire glowing inside, four thick legs ending in pale claws, and a long red tail curling up behind
hands: it has no weapon: it fights with its fanged maw and claws

strike.1: crouch: the weight shifts back onto the hind legs and the body sinks lower, the head drops level with the shoulders and aims at the lower-right, all four clawed paws planted, the fanged maw gaping with fire glowing inside
strike.2: coil, the wind-up extreme: the body drawn back toward the upper-left and pressed low over the folded hind legs, the chest close to the ground, the head low and aimed at the lower-right, the long red tail held stiff out behind, the fanged maw gaping; the face looks to the lower-right
